commits.purpose: source-side bench load-path correction and fail-closed scene QA
enforce bench interface correction/QA on benchmark scene save
bind bench interface QA into native 4K review preflight and render checkpoints

sourceEvidence: LOD0/1 timber slat bottom Y=0.539 m while the previous steel bearer top was Y=0.5275 m, leaving an 11.5 mm positive air gap.
The previous 560 mm-high precast supports topped at Y=0.560 m, penetrating the old bearer by 77.5 mm and the timber slat envelope by 21 mm at the support locations.
LOD0 bolt head bottom was Y=0.584 m while timber top was Y=0.581 m, leaving the head 3 mm visibly unsupported in source geometry.
LOD0 bolt centers were Z=+/-0.180 m while the outer slat begins at |Z|=0.184 m; the bolt center therefore sat in the inter-slat air gap rather than over timber.
LOD2/3 seat proxy bottom was Y=0.5075 m while support top was Y=0.560 m, causing 52.5 mm proxy/support penetration.

implementation.groundInterface: Precast supports remain shallowly hidden below grade by at least 50 mm while the darker moisture/splash sleeve starts at grade and is confined to the lowest 120 mm visible zone.
implementation.materials: Existing final furniture microdetail remains authoritative: timber and concrete are dielectric, final exposed bare steel is fully metallic, and no contact shadow/highlight is baked into albedo.

referenceResearch.use: Current Japanese natural-wood landscape-bench product/drawing class only; no current product dimension is copied into or claimed as historical evidence for the circa-2000 fictional scene.

qaEnforcement: Machine-readable contract locks load-path dimensions, material response metadata, hard contact/embed limits, lookdev requirement and zero automatic Visual Fidelity credit.
Benchmark scene save rebuilds park furniture, applies physical profiles/LOD/microdetail, corrects the bench load path, then validates it fail-closed.
Complete Native 4K Review Packet validates the bench before reflection capture, after reflection synchronization immediately before Camera.Render, and after still sealing before temporal capture.

Positive slat-to-bearer or bearer-to-support gaps, bolt heads outside the 1-4 mm embed range, bolt centers outside the intended outer slats, or insufficient hidden support embedment fail source/runtime QA.

implementationReadiness.reason: The remaining seven readiness points are reserved for actual Unity compile/runtime evidence. Source-side construction correction cannot satisfy them.

expectedVisualScoreImpact.geometryConstruction: Potentially avoids a critical floating/interpenetration failure and may recover roughly 1-2 Geometry points only if native 4K evidence confirms clean contacts and believable proportions.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.lightingReflections: Potential small improvement from physically located contact shadows and removal of positive light gaps; no points are assumed.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.temporalLod: Potential stability improvement because LOD2/3 supports now meet the proxy-seat underside rather than penetrating it; this must be judged in temporal evidence.

nextBlocker: No Unity 6000.3.0f1 runner/workflow is present. When one appears, stop speculative expansion, run the formal native-4K packet, inspect the bench at 100% for light leaks, z-fighting, bolt seating, timber/steel/concrete response separation and LOD continuity, and fix the rendered defect rather than weakening the gate.
